chunks: And al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “Whoever marries has safeguarded half of his religion.”
And in another hadith: “So let him have taqwa of Allah regarding the remaining half.”

key_terms.فَلْيَتَّقِ: so let him have taqwa; let him fear Allah consciously

ai.seo_question: How does marriage safeguard half of a believer’s religion in hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the great virtue of marriage and presents it as a means of protecting a person’s religion. It also emphasizes that after marriage, one must still maintain taqwa in what remains of one’s religious responsibility.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4342 - It is narrated from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Abdillah (as), that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Whoever gets married has safeguarded half of his religion."
In another narration, it is added: "So let him fear Allah (swt) regarding the remaining half."
